dispositions.REQ-276: vNEXT — P0 git-aware duplicate-source gate defined by the approved V2 framework; not built. CORRECTED (2026-08-09, audit §867): "not built" understates it — MEASURED, two of three DoD clauses HOLD. (1) Zero tracked duplicates exist. (2) A seeded TRACKED duplicate fails the gate: force-adding db/tenant/migrations/"0001_ledger_core 3.sql" turns check:invariants RED — via a shadowing globSync wrapper in tools/checks/invariants.ts that strips collision duplicates from all 15 glob sites, so the dup is absent from the migrations set while git ls-files still lists it and the stray-SQL fence fires (the message misdescribes it as "stray SQL outside db/*/migrations" for a file that is inside it). .gitignore carries four name-collision rules, broadened at §253 to cover 2-99. (3) FALSE: ignored artifacts DO alter authoritative counts — one git-ignored duplicate *.test.ts moves vitest from 72 files/1,122 tests to 73/1,124. It is a copy so it passes, which is the danger: a test-count floor satisfied by a duplicate would hide a DELETED test file while staying green. Also measured: 12 files under tools/ walk the filesystem with neither git-awareness nor the duplicate filter (mostly scanners, where a doubled scan yields the same verdict). The row stays vNEXT for the vitest-collection clause; closing it would extend deferred scope, so it is filed with the measurement rather than fixed.
